{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
# First, replace commas in revenue and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders again
total_revenue = df['revenue'].sum()
print("Total revenue before filtering:", total_revenue)

# Filter out QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]
print("Shape after removing QA orders:", df_clean.shape)

# Verify no QA orders remain
qa_check = df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders still present:", len(qa_check))

# Verify that revenue is now numeric
type_check = df_clean['revenue'].dtype
print("Revenue dtype:", type_check)

# Check for refunded orders
df_clean['status'].value_counts()"}
